TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() obtains pricingRuleId and pricingRuleRequest, resolves auditUserId from header parameter USERCODE, and calls ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules(pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest, auditUserId). The library loads the current rule with getPricingRuleById(id), loads its active details with getDetailsByRuleId(id), copies the persisted pricingRuleType into the request DTO, validates allowed modifications with PricingRuleValidator.validatePut(existing, pricingRule, hasActiveChildren), checks duplicate rules with checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPut(pricingRule), and resolves each detail value with fillDetailValues(pricingRule.getDetails(), queriesMap). 2. Decisions and branches: if getPricingRuleById(id) returns null, executePutPricingRules adds advice ABKO10000405 and returns null. If actual.getActive() is false, if status is not PAA, PAU, REJ, SYE or SYC, if status is SYC and hasActiveChildren is true, if validateActivationDate(effectiveDate) returns false, if a synchronized rule changes restricted fields, if pricingRuleType is not V, R or P, if duplicate functional scope is found, if payment method overlap is found, or if a detail query is missing or returns no value, the corresponding PricingRuleException is raised and converted to advice. If existing.getStatus() is SYC, handleSycUpdate creates a new version with a new rule id; otherwise syncDetails inserts new details, deactivates removed ones, sets status to PAU, sets parentId, and updates the existing rule. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules loads the current rule and its details from PricingRuleRepository, maps persisted detail rows with mapDetails, validates rule state and allowed changes with PricingRuleValidator.validatePut, validates duplicates with PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPut and PutPricingRuleDuplicateValidator, resolves detail display values with PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues, and then either creates a new SYC version with handleSycUpdate or updates the current rule with syncDetails and updatePricingRule. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: ABKO10000405 is added in executePutPricingRules when the requested pricing rule does not exist. ABKO10000407 is thrown in validatePut when actual.getActive() is false. ABKO10000408 is thrown in validatePut when the current status is outside PAA, PAU, REJ, SYE or SYC. ABKO10000417 is thrown in validatePut when the current status is SYC and the rule has active children. ABKO10000413 is thrown in validatePut when validateActivationDate(effectiveDate) fails because the start date is before the current date. ABKO10000414 is thrown in validatePut when a synchronized rule modifies restricted fields. ABKO10000416 is thrown in validatePricingRuleType when pricingRuleType is not V, R or P. ABKO10010401 is thrown by throwPricingRuleAlreadyExists when an existing rule already matches the functional scope under duplicate validation. ABKO10010415 is thrown by throwPaymentMethodOverlap when a variable rule overlaps an existing payment method. ABKO10010004 is thrown in fillDetailValues when the configured lookup query is missing, returns an empty value, or raises NoResultException for a detail id and entity type. ABKO00000010 is thrown in deactivateDetail or added in updatePricingRule when the database update result is 0. executePutPricingRules converts caught PricingRuleException instances into addAdviceWithDescription(e.getCode(), e.getDescription()), and assignSeverityError sets Severity.EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: executePutPricingRules returns the mutated pricingRuleRequest DTO on success and returns null on advice paths. execute() always calls setPricingruleresponse(pricingRule) without a guard, so pricingRuleResponse is assigned with the returned DTO or null. On successful non-SYC updates the response status is set to PAU and parentId is set before updatePricingRule. On successful SYC updates handleSycUpdate sets parentId to the original id, increments the version, sets status to PAU, inserts the new rule and details, and replaces the response id with the new pricing rule id.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Modifies a pricing rule by loading the current rule and its details, validating allowed changes and duplicates, resolving detail values, and then updating the current rule or creating a new version for SYC rules.
